scope: One installation with its environments on a clean machine, not a real server. An upgrade to a version with a newer PostgREST (v14.15 to v14.16) through lab/upgrade.py and a restart. A manual rollback by the operator after that upgrade was confirmed. An upgrade to a version whose PostgREST never answers, which the supervisor moved back by itself. Data is compared by row counts, and the control catalog by its schema version and a digest of its organizations, projects, environments and memberships, not every table.

checks.check: the upgrade finished and was confirmed
the checkout is on the new version
every REST container runs the new PostgREST
the control catalog is at the schema it had before the upgrade
organizations, projects, environments and memberships in the control catalog are unchanged
users, identities, buckets and files are unchanged in every environment
Auth, REST and the console answer, and the console /health answers 200
application traffic is served, not held
the operator moved back from the confirmed upgrade
the checkout is on the version before the upgrade
every REST container runs that version's PostgREST again
after confirmation the control state was kept, not restored
the control catalog is at the schema it had before the upgrade

users, identities, buckets and files are unchanged in every environment

application traffic is served, not held

the checkout is on the last good version
